anchors.name: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
anchors.binding: A recommendation adopted by UNESCO's 193 member states in November 2021.
anchors.asks: Shared principles for the ethics of AI, adopted by UNESCO's 193 member states.
anchors.evidence: A test report on your own questions, with every failure listed, before the system leaves pilot.

anchors.name: EU AI Act Art 27 and Annex III 5(a)
anchors.binding: Law in the EU: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, as amended by Regulation (EU) 2026/1744.
anchors.asks: Public bodies, and private bodies that provide public services, that deploy a high-risk AI system listed in Annex III, except point 2 (critical infrastructure), must assess its impact on fundamental rights before first use and notify the regulator of the results, from 2 December 2027 (as amended in July 2026). The assessment can rely on an existing DPIA. Eligibility for public assistance benefits and services is an Annex III 5(a) use, and public-authority deployers may use only high-risk systems that are registered (Art 26(8)).
anchors.evidence: Measured test results and a failure list on your own cases, which your team can draw on for its fundamental rights impact assessment.

anchors.name: OECD, Governing with Artificial Intelligence
anchors.asks: Reviews about 200 uses of AI across 11 core government functions. It asks governments to prioritise uses with high benefit and manageable risk, to measure benefits and harms, and to combine enablers, guardrails and engagement. It notes that many uses stay at the pilot stage.
anchors.evidence: A measured test on your own questions that shows whether a use case is ready to leave pilot.

anchors.name: G7 Toolkit for AI in the Public Sector
anchors.binding: A toolkit prepared for the 2024 Italian G7 presidency.
anchors.asks: Turns principles into practice for public bodies: strategy, user voice, frameworks for responsible use, and scaling what works.
anchors.evidence: A pilot exit test and a re-test plan for each AI use case.

anchors.name: UNESCO Ethical Impact Assessment
anchors.binding: A tool for applying the Recommendation on the Ethics of AI in public procurement.
anchors.asks: Asks officials to scope whether AI is the right tool, then to test the system against the Recommendation's principles before and after deployment.
anchors.evidence: A test report before deployment, and a re-test report after each change.
